description: Browse the hand-picked dorm essentials catalog for a storefront. marketplace=amazon.com (US) returns verified amazon.com /dp/ product links; marketplace=amazon.se returns the Swedish catalog with amazon.se /dp/ links. Optional q/category filters.

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront id (us, se) or domain (amazon.com, amazon.se). Recommended. For US shoppers pass marketplace=amazon.com (US catalog, amazon.com /dp/ links, tag sw-dormkit-20). If omitted: locale en-US selects amazon.com, anything else falls back to amazon.se (never an error).

q.description: Optional text filter, e.g. twin xl, lamp

name: list_catalog_items
title: List curated dorm catalog
